summary: [[character:milo]] surveys [[location:omicron2-eridani]] and finds the oxygen-bearing double planets he names [[location:vulcan]] and [[location:romulus]]. Uneasy about how he left [[location:epsilon-eridani]], he promises [[character:bill]] reports while developing local resources and sending biological exploration drones to investigate whether their related life can support [[species:human|humans]]. Bill's requests include a future space station and [[technology:ami]], while [[character:riker]] is traveling toward [[location:sol]] with a newly made copy that has not turned out as expected.

introducing.name: Omicron2 Eridani
introducing.description: A triple-star system whose B and C stars orbit each other and whose pair orbits [[location:omicron-eridani-a]] at about 470 AU. Its survey identifies several outer Jovian planets, a probable asteroid belt, and the double planets [[location:vulcan]] and [[location:romulus]].

introducing.name: Omicron Eridani A
introducing.description: The somewhat smaller primary star of [[location:omicron2-eridani]]. It is a possible, though nonideal, host for habitable planets.

introducing.name: Vulcan
introducing.description: The larger member of a double planet at 0.81 AU from [[location:omicron-eridani-a]] in the [[location:omicron2-eridani]] system, also designated OE-1A, with about 0.9 [[location:earth]] masses, orbiting [[location:romulus]] every 20 days. On the cool side of the habitable zone but warmed by a thicker, carbon-dioxide-rich atmosphere, it has oceans, oxygen and large green land areas, with animals nearly as large as dinosaurs and life probably related to Romulus's.
introducing.visual_description: Clouds, extensive oceans, atmospheric oxygen, and large green land areas are visible.

introducing.name: Romulus
introducing.description: The smaller member of the double planet with [[location:vulcan]] at 0.81 AU from [[location:omicron-eridani-a]] in the [[location:omicron2-eridani]] system. It has about 0.7 [[location:earth]] masses and orbits Vulcan every 20 days at about 364,000 km. It is on the cool side of the habitable zone, with an atmosphere, extensive oceans, atmospheric oxygen, and large green land areas. Its ice caps may be seasonal; its northern hemisphere is in mid-spring and its year lasts 285 Earth days. No animal life larger than a wolf has been found, and its ecosystems appear sparse. Cellular analysis indicates that its life is probably related to Vulcan's.
introducing.visual_description: Clouds, extensive oceans, atmospheric oxygen, large green land areas, and ice caps are visible.

introducing.name: asteroid belt
introducing.description: A probable asteroid belt just inside [[location:oe-2]]. It is surprisingly diffuse and takes two full revolutions around [[location:omicron-eridani-a]] to map with [[technology:suddar]].

introducing.name: OE-2
introducing.description: The inner Jovian of [[location:omicron2-eridani]], with almost three [[location:jupiter]] masses and a twenty-hour rotation. Huge horizontal weather bands form perhaps a dozen cells. It has several hundred satellites, at least 60 spherical and about half of those with significant atmospheres; a couple of dozen smaller satellites have deposits of metallic and heavy elements.
introducing.visual_description: Huge horizontal weather bands form perhaps a dozen cells.

introducing.name: Outer Jovian 1
introducing.description: One of several outer Jovian planets observed in the [[location:omicron2-eridani]] system.

introducing.name: Outer Jovian 2
introducing.description: One of several outer Jovian planets observed in the [[location:omicron2-eridani]] system.

introducing.name: Outer Jovian 3
introducing.description: One of several outer Jovian planets observed in the [[location:omicron2-eridani]] system.

introducing.name: planetary exploration drone
introducing.description: A practical drone design for planetary exploration, with variants for surveillance and biological analysis. Its biological-analysis version carries systems for examining local life and mechanical stomachs that process organics as a human stomach would; sample-output analysis takes about a day.

introducing.name: autofactory
introducing.description: An automated factory used to gather and refine resources and to produce drones.

introducing.name: scavenging units
introducing.description: Units that gather, refine, and transport material within a stellar system on a regular schedule.

updates.current_state: At [[location:omicron2-eridani]], surveying [[location:vulcan]] and [[location:romulus]] while testing their biological compatibility for [[species:human|humans]].
